q: By the end of June 2027, no South Korean-flagged or South Korean-operated vessel is attacked or seized in an incident that the South Korean government or the shipping company officially attributes to Iran
basis: The 2021 seizure of the Hankuk Chemi, the May 2026 attack on the Namu (attacker unconfirmed), and Iran's Korean-language warning of September 7 · Checked against prior attempts, Iran issue
rs: Statements by South Korea's Foreign Ministry or Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, or by the shipping company
